conflicts.axis: Video Caption Source and Fallback Logic

reviews.why: This atom directly conflicts with DA-005 regarding the video captioning logic. DA-004 proposes strictly using `bridge_output.description`, which could result in videos being sent without any caption if `description` is empty. This is less robust than DA-005's approach, which includes a fallback to `self._format(payload)` to ensure an informative caption is always present, improving user experience.
reviews.fix: Reconcile the captioning logic to prioritize `payload.description` (or `bridge_output.description` if they refer to the same data) when available, and fall back to `self._format(payload)` if the description is empty. This combines the intent of using a specific description with the robustness of always providing a caption, aligning with the more comprehensive approach of DA-005.
